text:
marie: quick heads-up — capacity sensor drift in our mixed-gpu pools. eu-west3 spot availability probe showing a sustained falloff since ~03:00 UTC. eviction rate jumped ~3x compared to baseline, seeing service impact on lower-priority batches. pinging ops to correlate.

ops-bot: ALERT: spot_availability_drop (eu-west3-mixed) fired at 1977777777 — interruption_rate = 5.9% over 15m (threshold 1%). link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/1977777777 :rotating_light:

jamal: @marie can you paste the PromQL you used to spot this?

marie: sure — quick slice I ran:
```
# interruptions per capacity over 15m by pool
sum(rate(preemptible_interruptions_total{region="eu-west3"}[15m])) by (pool)
/
sum(gpu_capacity_total{region="eu-west3"}) by (pool)
```
This shows mixed-pool 'mosaic-mixed-4' at ~0.059 (6%) while baseline is ~0.008.

alex: saw a cloud notification earlier about rolling host maintenance in eu-west3 (02:50-04:00 UTC) — could be correlated: https://cloud.status/eu-west3/maintenance . Also saw higher network retransmits on telemetry for that zone. :eyes:

luis: from a mitigation POV we should: 1) move latency-sensitive routes off preemptible for the next 30m, 2) throttle background batch window sizes, 3) increase grace for cache reuse to lower token volume.

jamal: ok i'll apply a short routing override for async workloads to force on-demand in eu-west3 for 10m. command i'm about to run:
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/routes/override" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"route":"async-inference","region":"eu-west3","force_pool":"on-demand-eu-west3","ttl":600}'
```

marie: please also file a small PR to bump alert severity: escalate to critical if interruption_rate > 3% for 30m (we're currently at 1%/15m). this pattern is causing real SLO risk, not just noise. i'll draft the runbook change and cost calc.

ops-bot: NOTIFICATION: routing override applied by jamal at 1977777890 — async-inference -> on-demand-eu-west3 (ttl=600) :thumbsup:

alex: additional idea — create a short-lived composite metric to reduce flapping: composite = 2*eviction_rate + (1 - available_capacity_ratio). if composite > 0.08 for 20m then page. reduces sensitivity to small blips but catches true capacity collapses. i'll sketch this in the runbook.

luis: good call. also recommend adding a sliding window and backoff (30m cool-down) before auto-fallback to cheaper pools. i'll put a note in #eng-infra-alerts for review.

marie: thank you all — i'll post the PR for alert change + runbook edits and a 24h cost estimate. rough calc: moving ~200 GPUs to on-demand in eu-west3 for the next 12 hours ~= +$2100 (estimate), full day ~= +$4200, which is acceptable to protect production SLOs. tagging @finance for awareness.

jamal: once alert PR is merged, i'll add the composite query to our dashboards and a Grafana panel for quick triage.

marie: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. if anyone sees this spike elsewhere, ping here and include region/pool and the prom slice. :wave:
